write_ids_codes: write vector ids and encoded codes to numpy files in /tmp for later retrieval
read_ids_codes: read previously saved vector ids and encoded codes from numpy files in /tmp
write_template_index: write a trained FAISS PQ template index to disk for reuse across user shards
read_template_index_instance: read a previously saved FAISS template index from disk to encode or search vectors
create_grouped_bar_chart: create a grouped bar chart with matplotlib showing compression ratio vs recall at one
